title: Public posts
summary: When one of your photos or deaths is shared on our Instagram or Facebook story, you now get a chat message and an inbox note with a link to see it. A new Public posts switch keeps your photos and deaths off our Discord and socials if you would rather they stay private. It starts off in Kid mode.
highlights: Chat and inbox message with a View it link when you are featured
Public posts switch on the welcome card and in Options
The welcome card is now two columns so it fits small screens, and asks once more
